descriptions: You wake in {LOCATION}. The smell of {NOUN} is everywhere. Somewhere ahead, something stirs.
A {ADJ} light reveals a {CHARACTER} watching you from the far end of the room. They don't speak.

commands.look: The {ADJ} space stretches in all directions. A {CHARACTER} lingers near the exit. The path north is open.
commands.talk to {CHARACTER}: The {CHARACTER} says only: 'Move. While you still can.'

latents.fact: a tarnished coin half-buried in the dust near the entrance — someone dropped it in a hurry
latents.item_desc: A worn coin with a face you don't recognise. One side has been filed smooth.

latents.fact: the {CHARACTER} has been scratching marks into the wall behind them — a count, or a warning
there is a gap between the baseboard and the floor where something flat has been pushed through
